title: Course Schedule II
description:
Each pair [a,b] requires course b before course a. Return a schedule of all courses, or [] if no full schedule exists.

When several schedules are possible, return the lexicographically smallest sequence: among currently available courses, always take the smallest ID. This makes the output unique.

Example 1:

Input: numCourses = 4, prerequisites = [[1,0],[2,0],[3,1],[3,2]]
Output: [0,1,2,3]

After course 0, both 1 and 2 are ready; choose 1 first.

Example 2:

Input: numCourses = 2, prerequisites = [[1,0],[0,1]]
Output: []

The cycle prevents any complete schedule.

Example 3:

Input: numCourses = 3, prerequisites = []
Output: [0,1,2]

With no dependencies, ascending ID order wins.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= numCourses <= 100; course IDs are 0 through numCourses - 1.
  • 0 <= prerequisites.length <= 1000; every pair [course, prerequisite] uses valid, distinct IDs.
  • Pairs are unique; an empty schedule is possible.
